reason: The first official-archive execution stopped before feature construction or candidate PnL because the original loader asserted a completely continuous intersection across six one-minute price streams. A second diagnostic execution also stopped before feature construction or candidate PnL after preserving the source archives and full log. Inspection of those preserved, checksum-verified archives established source gaps and millisecond funding timestamps that require an explicit causal mapping rather than timeline compression.

correction.price_time_axis: Build the regular UTC one-minute grid over the common source bounds. Preserve each absent source observation as NaN. Never forward-fill, backfill, interpolate, synthesize OHLC, or compress time across gaps.
correction.feature_and_order_eligibility: All feature, signal, entry, stop, timeout and capacity paths require finite observed inputs. Entry remains the next exact contiguous USD-M one-minute open; gaps cannot create or bridge a trade.
correction.funding_event_time: Retain the official funding calc_time, including millisecond offsets, for inclusion only when calc_time is in (entry_time, exit_time].
correction.funding_valuation: Value each funding event at the official mark-price open of its containing UTC minute. Only when that exact mark observation is absent, use the exact same-minute official USD-M contract open as a disclosed fallback; never use a prior or future price.
correction.audit: Emit source-by-source gap counts, funding timestamp-offset counts, mark/fallback counts, and zero unvalued events before candidate results.

unchanged_contract.account: one global slot; 0.5% planned-loss risk; 3x notional cap; 0.1% completed-signal-minute USD-M quote-volume participation
unchanged_contract.economic_gate: At least 150 trades; positive 12/18bp geometric growth and top-10%-removed return; 12bp PF >= 1.10, MDD <= 15%, top-five positive share <= 35%, positive median trade, both half-years positive.
